target_text:
Cell phones are powerful electronic tools for students to use in classroom. Cell phones are now the most popular device that we can take with us wherever we go because it provide useful information such as news and climate. It also can be use as map or dictionary. The good and amazing point is that it does not take to much space like a laptop or a computer, and it is accessible for the worldwide. Cell phones can be useful for students in classroom because they provide almost all the apps that a computer contains, cell phones are more flexible than computers, and school does not have to waste more money buying computers.

First reason is, cell phones provide almost all the apps that a computer contains. In a computer, students can use Google

classroom, fcps blackboard, Google docs, Google drive, and PowerPoint to do class works and homework such as essay, project, and presentation. Now, lets see what students can do with the cell phones. Just like working with a computer, students can works with their cell phones using the same apps to do any type of work. Today, cell phones contain many apps because of their capacity. With the cell phone on students hand, they can perform any classwork and homework just like a computer. If students use their cell phones all the time the communicate with their family, friends, and use social media, then they can use it to do important works too. Student some times abhor working with computer and prefer using their phones because computer takes more time to turn on, and it does not have good internet all the time. All the time I prefer using my cell phone than a dictionary because it takes less time to find the definition and it provides examples where to use the word that I am searching for. Also, having a computer and my cell phone in front of me, and if I have to choose of of them to work with, I would choose my cell phone for the simple reason that my phone works faster than that computer.

Second reason, cell phones are more flexible than computers. It is logic that everyone would prefer using their own device than a computer because a computer is heavy

than a cell phone. A cell phone is almost the same as a computer but more smaller and and it makes calls. Well, cell phones do not need too much space than a computer which make them unique and easy to carry. In school, 99.9% of the students have cell phones and most of them use their phone to do their work because some of them do not have computer and some of them prefer using their phones because they work more faster by typing and searching with their phones. I have been seen many students using their phone to do multiple things such as listening music, searching in internet and writing at the same time. I do the same as they do and the reason always is that cell phones work faster than a computer. In my case, I do not have computer, and the computers in the library in the school are always busy which do not give me any alternative that to work with my phone.

Third reason, School does not need to waste more money buying computers. If school allows students to use their device in classroom, the school would not need to buy more computers. The school would safe a lot of money and students would work more comfortable with their phones. In my personal opinion, the money the school would safe can be used to help students with personal finance, or in other aspects where the school need to invert money. On the another hand, computers are necessary for test which means that the school will still have computers but those computers would be used in the test day only. Those computers would take years to have any problems because students would not going to use them all the time. So, the school does not need to worry about repairing or buying more computers constantly.

While some people may claim saying that schools should not allow student to use cell phone in classroom because it distract students, in respond to these people, if cell phones provide more benefits to students, then school should allow students to use them. Now, because there is always one or some students that instead doing work they get distract and they distract other students, then the teacher should take their phones and those student will loose their privilege using their devices. If the school allows students to use cell phones in classroom, then the school needs to pass rules that all students must follow in order to avoid problems related with cell phones.

In conclusion, cell phones must be allowed in classroom for students to use because they provide almost all the apps that a computer contains. Students can perform any type of work using different apps in their cell phones. Cell phones are more flexible than computers because it is easy to carry and does not need much space than computers. As a good benefits school does not have to waste more money buying computers. Because cell phones will substitute the computers.
